01

“their sides forsake their beds”

An explanation transmitted from Anas ibn Mālik (Q 32:16).

771
Explanation from Anas ibn Mālik No. 771: 1

Anas ibn Mālik

English
Transmission wording
771: 1. Abu Hudhayfa related to us; Sufyan related to us, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Anas ibn Malik, on His words
"their sides forsake their beds": He said, between the maghrib and isha prayers (verse 16).
العربية
771: 1 حدثنا أو حُذَيْفَةَ ثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ ابن مالك في قوله جنوبهم عن المضاجع قَالَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ (الآية 16) .

02

“the lesser punishment, short of the greater punishment”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibrāhīm and ʿAbd Allāh (Q 32:21).

772
Explanation from Ibrāhīm No. 772: 2

Ibrāhīm

English
Transmission wording
772: 2. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim:
"the lesser punishment, short of the greater punishment": He said, calamities in wealth and children (verse 21).
العربية
772: 2 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ علي مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الأَدْنَى دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الأكبر قال المصايب في الأموال والأولاد (الآية 21) .
Edition record 371479 · p. 240Link to report ↗
773
Report from ʿAbd Allāh No. 773: 3

ʿAbd Allāh

English
Transmission wording
773: 3. Sufyan, from al-Suddi, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Abd Allah, who said:
It is the day of Badr.
العربية
773: 3 سفيان عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ هُوَ يَوْمُ بَدْرٍ.
